title: Zach's Journey

season: FF4
format: prose
---

*Zach is 5*

Zach is looking in the mirror in his luxurious room within the Mansion. He can see the Big Dipper today! His mom says that his eyes are what makes him special… his dad however, doesn’t really like his eyes, so Zach doesn’t maintain eye contact with him. Oh right… might as well introduce Zach and family.

*Zacharias Smith, the only child of his mother Maria and his father John Smith. The family are well known people with them being among the higher class and John having political ties. They are respected… at least Maria and John are… not many people know of Zach’s existence, due to Zach being a young child and his dad not really wanting people to see him. Due to this, Zach never really went outside, so most of his knowledge came from books and the occasional news cast. He loves his mom and his dad, even though his dad doesn’t really show Zach any recognition, always muttering something along the lines of “damn brat”, “eyes of a freak”, or the most common one, “no time for this”. Zach doesn’t understand why his dad is always cold to him but he tries his best to be the “best son”.*

*Anyway, now that introductions are over, let’s get back to it.*

The young boy rushes out of his room to tell his discovery to someone, he runs through the large halls of his house. After a few minutes of searching, his finds his dad saying goodbye to someone in a suit. Zach doesn’t care though, he was too excited to share his findings, he skids to a halt right next to his dad and tugs on his pristine white pant leg.

“Dad! Dad! I-I found the-”

“Zacharias!” John interrupts, Zach stops speaking. John then swats at Zach’s hand, causing him to retract his hand from John’s pant leg. “What did I say about touching me?”

“B-but dad… I just wanted to tell you that my eyes-” Zach began again.

“I. do not. care.” John interrupts again with gritted teeth. He then puts his fingers on the bridge of his nose. “I thought I made it clear that I *do not* like your eyes. They’re ugly and unappealing Zacharias. I never want to see them again, understand?” Zach looked down and nodded. John only scoffed. “Now go find someone else to bother.” John walks away, leaving Zach in the hallway. Tears start falling as Zach walked back to his room.

*Zach was 9 when the mirror went away and he started hiding his eyes. At night he can hear yelling.*

*Zach is 10*

Zach is giving Maria a hug outside the mansion, she has her belongings packed in the car and she is crying. Zach doesn’t fully understand what’s wrong… his eyes are covered… why is mom leaving?

“Will you come back mom?” Zach asks, Maria breaks the hug and shakes her head.

“I’m sorry baby… but I can’t come back.” She chokes out.

“W-why not?” Zach is starting to cry as well.

“I just can’t Zach, I’m so sorry. I need you to be strong for me, ok? Remember, your eyes are beautiful, don’t let anyone tell you otherwise. I love you Zach, always.” And with that she kisses Zach on his forehead, enters the car, and starts to drive away. Zach tries to chase after her, but is caught by men in suits. He shouts out, but it falls on deaf ears. As he gets dragged through the front door. Zach faintly hears John say “damn brat trying to get me in trouble.” And with that, Maria was never heard from again.

*Zach is 15*

Zach feels alone in his own house, it’s almost as if both his parents left, but he knows his dad is still here. Zach rarely sees him, and every time they’d “interact”, Zach would say “Hi” and John glares in Zach’s direction and then disappears again. Zach is confused, after all he covered his eyes, what else is there to do?

*Zach is 17*

Something special happens, John and Zach are having breakfast together… however the tension is so thick that when Zach would cut the butter to spread on his toast, he would cut the tension as well. John is no longer seen without a bottle of alcohol in his grip now. Zach’s getting tired, he’s tried *so* hard to gain John’s favor: gave him fresh bottles, only spoke when spoken to (although John practically doesn’t speak to Zach already), stays out of John’s way, and heck, Zach had his eyes covered so much that he can see normally now. He needed answers.

“Dad?”

“What did I say about talking?” John says sharply.

“But I have a question.”

“And I told you to stop talking.”

“No.” Zach blurted, he has no idea where this boldness came from, John is giving Zach the death glare, but Zach doesn’t care. “What am I doing wrong Dad? I’ve done everything you asked. But yet you still look at me like you don’t want me to exist?”

“Stop talking Zacharias.”

“No! I’m tired of being treated like a nobody.”

“I said *stop talking.*”

“No!” Zach stands up. “What am I doing wrong? What do I need to change about myself? Or… maybe you are the probl-”

“SHUT UP YOU DAMN BRAT!” John interrupts and throws his bottle at Zach. It shatters against his skin and one of the shards lodges itself in Zach’s cheek. He stumbles back as John angrily gets up from his chair. “You want to know why I *despise* you so badly? Because you were a disappointment from the beginning! Your eyes are hideous and ever since that *bitch* left, you remind me *so* much of her that I hate you! So let me make myself clear, *Zacharias.*” Zach looks at John, even though he’s wearing a cloth over his eyes, tears still fall down his face.

“You. Will. Be. Nothing. More. Then. A. *Disappointment*. I never want to hear you speak again, I swear to *God* if I hear another word, it’ll be more than my bottle than you’ll feel. *Understand*?” Zach nods. “Now, *get out of my sight*.” Zach didn’t need to be told twice, he sprints out of the room, and to an infirmary, not telling the nurses what really happened.

*Zach is 27*

Zach is tired, just tired. for 10 years, for *10 years* he’s had to deal with John, and he's sick of it. So, with a packed bag, a new outfit, and the mindset of “*I need out*” Zach made his way to the door of his- no- *John’s* house. But not before stopping in the living room and seeing the family heirloom hanging above the mantle of the fireplace. The Smith family sword *Oblivion*… Zach knows John isn’t going to miss it, so Zach takes it. After all, it’s a big bad world out there, having a weapon isn’t a bad idea. And with Oblivion strapped to his back, Zach sneaks his way outside.

***

Zach was a couple miles in when he stopped in front of the station. He takes a deep breath, this is it. He can finally live his life, whatever that might be, no more yelling, no more bottles, no more expectations. He walks through the door and gets in line, he pulls out his pen and pad in case he needs to talk… those scars still need to heal. But he was free! He’s going on this ship and going to who knows where and starting a new life! Hopefully it will be quiet, and peaceful, and most of all, he’ll be *happy*.

Cut to him at the front of the line wondering what god has forsaken him when his implants won’t work…. *Fucking John*.

Zach silently apologizes and gets out of line. As he was walking away, he sighed. Great… need to think of something different. He isn’t staying here because his implants won’t work, and he certainly isn’t going home. As he was about to leave, he overheard a few people…

“Hurry up with the loot already! We’re already late as it is.” A very high and proud Elf shouts to a mass of mismatched people. Zach was confused at the situation… when it hits him.

*Pirates*

Groups of people who are dangerous to those around them, they’re loud, annoying, and vulgar. They can be who they want to be, get rich quick, travel around the universe… and Zach is approaching the Elf. The Elf turns around to notice Zach behind him, he immediately puts his hand on the hilt of his cutlass.

“What the hell do you want?” The Elf spits, Zach flinches a little, he doesn’t run away. Instead he pulls out his pad and pen and starts writing.

“*Are you the captain?*” Zach rips the page off and presents it to the Elf. The man raises an eyebrow.

“What the? Well what do I look like to you? Some kind of girl scout? Fucking couse I’m the captain idiot!” Zach nods and writes again.

“*Got any room for another?*”

“Fuck no! Especially if it’s some mute hooded freak.” The captain swears. Zach isn’t budging.

“*But it just means I won’t complain and no one is going to recognize me if I get spotted*”

“I said no, you brat!”

“*Please? I have nowhere to go and in my mind, the more on board, the better, am I right Captain?*” The Captain’s eye twitches. He makes an annoyed sound before saying.

“FINE! But listen here, you work for *me*. You call me Captain, and nothing else. Even if you said it, if I hear complaining, I shoot you into space, *understand*? Zach nods. The Captain scoffs before turning around. “Now help us with the cargo already!” Zach nods again before grabbing the nearest box. The rest of the crew paid him no mind, just another pair of hands after all.

Once all the cargo got settled, Zach and crew entered the ship, it was a decent size, definitely enough to hold everyone, and the Captain gave Zach the tour of the necessities; sleeping quarters, common areas, bathrooms etc. Then the Captain left Zach to his own devices. Zach gets onto the nearest empty bed and just lays down and thinks about what just happened…

He joined a Pirate crew.

He’s the son of a well respected man who is of higher class and he joined *Pirates*.

Zach smiles, he doesn’t know why but he *smiles*. Maybe because he finally got out of the hellhole known as his house. Maybe because he’s defying his Dad, even though it doesn’t matter. But Zach is *happy*. He thinks he’ll stay here.

*Zach is 29*

He’s been doing this every chance he got. Every time they’d land somewhere and stay there, he’d sneak out and “practice” his sword skills… if you count swinging Oblivion around aimlessly as “practice”. He thinks he’s getting better, but it’s not like anyone is watching him-

“So that’s why I keep hearing the hatch opening and closing.” Zach almost yelled. Zach turns around to see the Captain look at him with his arms crossed, unamused. “So, what are you doing out here this late?” Zach sheaths Oblivion and gets out his pad and pen.

“*Practicing*” The Captain bursts out laughing. Zach raises an invisible eyebrow.

“Hahaha!! If that’s what you call practice. I’d be ashamed to call you a sword fighter!” Zach looks downcast. The Captain calms down from his laughing fit before drawing his cutlass. “Let me show you how it’s done. And I’m not repeating myself or slowing down, understand?” Zach is blown away. But he knows an opportunity when he sees one, so he hastily puts away his pen and pad and pulls out Oblivion. He then gets into what he thinks is a battle stance. The Captain sighs before saying. “Bend your knees and relax your shoulders!” Zach does so and the Captain nods. “Right… let’s begin.”

*Zach is 31*

They’re stranded on Barbona. The crew that’s left is Zach and the Captain. Everyone else is dead from the Torrid attacks that come and go. The ship was damaged from a run-in with the GU. Zach’s sure that those assholes think him and the Captain are dead, so they didn’t follow them to Barbona. And they were right, kinda. The supplies they have left will last a little while, but they will run out. They are literally dead on the water, and Zach doesn’t want to die, but what can he do? Even if the two rationed, it’s not like there’s nobody looking for them. And even when the Captain will eventually either off himself or kill Zach, the supplies will deplete. Zach sighs, the Captain is looking at the open water with binoculars, hoping to find *something*.

“Good news, found something!” The Captain cheers. Zach snaps his focus to the Captain. The Captain then gestures Zach over to himself and passes the binoculars to Zach. “Right ahead, see that ship? It doesn’t look damaged and look-” He points to a group of Torrids gathering next to the ship. “-If those things are going to attack it, that means people are on the ship! If we can manage to get to that ship unnoticed by both the crew and the Torrids and let those watery fucks kill them, that ship is free for the taking!” Zach’s eyes widen at the prospect of not being stranded and he smiles. The Captain smiles back. “Glad you agree with me, now let’s go already!” Zach scrambles to get Oblivion and his backpack and runs back to the open hatch, where the Captain has a raft ready.

The pair climbs on and rows to the ship, where the Torrids are already in full swing on their attack. They hear the crew inside shouting and fighting back, but no one is dropping. The Captain sighs before turning to Zach. “Looks like they’re putting up a fight… at this rate, the Torrids will notice us, so might as well join the fight. You go in and show them what you learned!” Zach nods and climbs onto the ship.

***

*Present day*

Zach wakes up in the middle of the night. It wasn’t nightmares this time, (“Thanks Bellow”), it was just… memories. Zach needs a drink, so he gets up to go to the kitchen on the ship. He hasn’t paid attention to how long he’s been here, but it felt like a lifetime ago since he joined the crew.

Once he got to the kitchen, Zach grabs a glass and fills it with water. Something catches the corner of his eye so he gets ready to book it.

“Oh Zach! You are awake quite early!” Morra’s cheery voice cuts through the shadows. Zach relaxes as he joins Morra in the common area.

“*I woke up from memories… nothing special.*” Zach types while taking sips from his cup.

“Interesting, would you like to talk about it?” Morra inquired. Zach shakes his head.

“*Nothing to talk about to be honest. Although it has got me thinking about stuff.*”

“Like what?”

“*Like what would I have done if I hadn't attacked you guys. The answer is I would be dead, but then I started thinking if I regret even meeting you guys…*”

“Well… do you?” Zach thought about it for a minute. Then he had a small smile on his face.

“*No*.”

“Oh good! Now then, I’m off, have a good night Zach!” Morra waves before walking… floating? Away. Zach waves as well before finishing off his glass, cleaning it, and putting it away. He walks back to his room and looked into his cracked mirror….

It *has* been awhile…

Zach takes a deep breath and takes off his blindfold.

…

….

…..

…….

He can see the Big Dipper.
